svg.text: Phase 6 · milestone 1 · Fixes and Settings: layout options
Dark theme. Settings today is one long page under three tabs (You, Devices, Household). Later milestones add more settings
(labor rates, Admin re-auth, email, document needs), so it gets a layout that grows. Groups below are the same in every option.
1 · A column of sections down the left (Recommended)
Like the app's own sidebar, one level in. Each section is short; Household's defaults appear only in Admin mode. The column remembers the last section.
Yours. Anything you don't choose follows the household's default.
On a phone (narrow window): the column is a list; tapping a section opens it, with ‹ Settings to go back.
Units and formats: distance, volume, economy, pressure, date, currency, language
Vehicles and messages: the squawk word, due warnings, when due messages start
Appearance and window: theme, keep on top (desktop)
Lock and PIN: lock after, change PIN, Lock now (desktop)
Defaults for everyone: the Household tab's rows, Admin mode only;
later milestones add labor rates, Admin re-auth, email, …
2 · One page, grouped cards, with a jump bar
Everything on one scrolling page, as today, but in titled cards. Chips at the top jump to a card. Household stays a tab (Admin mode).
… economy, pressure, date format, currency, language
… due warnings, when due messages start
Simplest change; but the page keeps growing, and the jump bar wraps on a phone.
3 · Sections with icons and a search box
Option 1 with a search: typing "pin" or "units" filters the column to matching settings. Closest to macOS System Settings.
More to build (a search over every setting's name); worth it once there are many more settings.
This can't be undone. To confirm, type:
5 · Lock now in the account menu (desktop with a PIN)
Locks at once, as Lock after does
when its time runs out. Shown only
on a desktop with a PIN set.
Drawn a page at a time (the records are already loaded). Newest first; months stay grouped.
Above and below the list. Jump to opens the page with that date's records; the filters (All, Fuel-ups, Readings) page the same way.
The page size: 100, or the person's choice in Settings (50 / 100 / 250).
